description.en: Reconstructive recall enhancer for DeepSeek Harness: reads the memory store of existing memory plugins (dsh-prime-memory), and before each model step rebuilds retrieved memory fragments into contextual, emotionally-toned recollection snippets instead of raw-text injection.
description.zh: 重建式回忆增强插件：只读现有记忆插件（dsh-prime-memory）的记忆库，在模型步骤前把检索到的记忆碎片「重建」为带语境与情绪的回忆片段注入，替代生硬的原文注入。
